title: AnalysisBuddy Plugin Manifest
description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the AnalysisBuddy plugin manifest file (plugin.json), protocol v1. Mirrors docs/spec/protocol-v1.md section 7. Unknown top-level fields are permitted (additionalProperties: true).

id.description: Globally unique plugin id. Must equal the id returned by initialize.

entry.description: Process launch entry, resolved relative to the plugin.json directory.

command.description: Executable command. Always resolved relative to the plugin.json directory; global PATH must not be relied on (interpreter-style entries excepted).

args.description: Command-line arguments. May be an empty array.

working_dir.description: Process working directory, resolved relative to the plugin.json directory. Defaults to the plugin.json directory.

match.description: File matching rules. Pre-filter at discovery; the authoritative judgement still goes through can_handle.

extensions.description: Claimed file extensions (lowercase, no dot). An empty array means fingerprint-only matching.

header_fingerprints.description: Header fingerprints: case-insensitive substring matches against the head sample; any hit makes the file a candidate.

min_protocol_version.description: Minimum required protocol version. When greater than the host-supported version the plugin is not loaded and the host suggests upgrading.
